blocks.title: open-readme
blocks.subtitle:
Designed GitHub READMEs for coding agents.
One coherent system, from overview to license.
blocks.meta: Editable JSON · Native Markdown · Local SVGs

items.title: Sections that belong together
items.description: Each section has Canvas, Console, Journal and Pipeline variants. Start with one system and keep its rhythm.

items.title: Your content, your config
items.description: Change the design, accent, typography and individual section layouts in JSON.

items.title: Files you can keep
items.description: Commit the Markdown and local assets. No hosted image service is required.

blocks.title: Get started
blocks.code:
npm install --save-dev github:luc3xhj/open-readme#v0.3.2
npx open-readme init --project cli --design pipeline
npx open-readme render --out README.preview.md --json
blocks.caption: Requires Node.js 22+. Edit the starter with your project’s facts before rendering.

blocks.title: Use with your agent
blocks.body:
Load the [agent skill](https://github.com/luc3xhj/open-readme/blob/main/skills/open-readme/SKILL.md), then ask:

> Design this repository’s README with open-readme. Verify the install and usage commands. Choose the useful sections, show me two complete design systems, and render to README.preview.md first.

Your agent inspects the repository, edits the config and runs the CLI. Review the result before replacing your README.

blocks.caption: A config fragment. Edit the ordered blocks to change your sections.

blocks.title: Use it in code
blocks.caption: The CLI and browser use this same renderer. The output has no runtime dependency.

blocks.title: Works on GitHub
blocks.body:
Commands, prose, tables and links stay selectable. GitHub switches the light and dark images automatically. Commit `README.md` and `assets/open-readme/` together.

JavaScript widgets and hover animation do not run in a GitHub README. The export uses native interactions and static SVGs.

Read the [configuration reference](https://github.com/luc3xhj/open-readme/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) and [section guide](https://github.com/luc3xhj/open-readme/blob/main/docs/sections.md).

blocks.title: Contribute
blocks.body: [Report an issue](https://github.com/luc3xhj/open-readme/issues) or read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/luc3xhj/open-readme/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Design a section around a reader’s task, then check it within the complete README.
